errors.evidence: The value for 2011 is described as approximately -2.5 billion EUR, but the chart shows it to be approximately -3.1 billion EUR.

errors.text_span: През 2013–2016 г. линията се движи в диапазона от -3,5 до -2,2 млрд. EUR, достигайки връх през 2016 г. около -2,0 млрд. EUR
errors.evidence: This statement contains two inaccuracies. First, the range for 2013-2016 is incorrect because the value in 2014 is approximately -4.0, which is outside the stated range of -3.5 to -2.2. Second, the peak value in 2016 is closer to -2.2 billion EUR, not -2.0 billion EUR.
The value for 2019 is described as approximately -3.0 billion EUR, whereas the chart shows it to be approximately -3.5 billion EUR.

The description does not mention the title of the chart as provided in the caption: 'Нетен износ (2004-2016 г., млрд. EUR)'. It also fails to note the discrepancy between the year range in the title (2004-2016) and the range on the x-axis (2004-2019).
